Note: Q1 is compulsory. Attempt one question each from the Units |, Il, Ill & IV.
Define vulnerabilities. Discuss how they are exploited in insider threats, with an
example from an organizational context,
Discuss the Lollipop Model and its significance in designing secure systems.
UNIT I
Explain the goals of cyber security in detail. Discuss three types of malicious
software—worms, ransomware, and backdoors—explaining their attack
methodologies, impacts, and defense mechanisms.
Phishing is one of the most prevalent cyber threats. Discuss its various types, such
as spear phishing, smishing, and vishing. Suggest detailed prevention techniques
that organizations and individuals can implement to counter these threats
effectively.
UNIT Il
Cyber terrorism is a growing threat to national and global security. Define cyber
terrorism, explain its impact on critical infrastructure, and provide a detailed
analysis of one documented cyber terrorism incident.
What is identity theft? Discuss in detail the various methods used by
cybercriminals to carry out identity theft, its impact on individuals and
organizations, and strategies for prevention, including technological and legal
measures.
What are hash functions? Explain their properties in detail and discuss the role of
the Secured Hash Algorithm (SHA) in data integrity and authentication, including
an example of its use in digital signatures.
